title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in Sierra Leone, implemented by partners Green Scenery, BAN, NMJD and SEND, promotes more inclusive, transparent, gender responsive and accountable institutions in Sierra Leone. The objectives of the grant are to support political inclusion and participation, particularly of women; transparent land governance and transparent financial management and accountability, by supporting rights holders to take action to advance their rights; influencing duty bearers and decision-makers to take action, and strengthening the agency of partner agencies and civil society. Objectives: Objective 1 - Rights Holders: Rights holders (women, men, groups, organisations, communities and peoples) are taking action to advance their rights Outcomes: Coalitions and networks are working together towards a more inclusive, transparent and accountable Sierra Leone, where rights are respected for land owners and users, women hold elected positions and social services are adequately resourced
